intent: Land the operator-directed ONE_WORLD custody ruling on main: narrow sublimation-forge-2026-08 owned_surfaces to cede exactly the guardian-feed surface (dharma_swarm/foundry/guardian_feed.py and tests/test_foundry_guardian_feed.py) so the fail-closed AgentOps packet-scope gate stops unioning this track's immutable merge-base ownership over PR #1493's already-green reconciliation of the Mac silvering (efca57e40 operator_approved flag) with the quorum-pinning guardian-feed tests. Every other foundry/RUDRA surface stays owned; the ceded globs become explicit file lists as a deliberate fail-closed form. Scope: docs/governance/ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml, the two generated track-include blocks (CLAUDE.md, docs/governance/SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md), and this packet.

commit.message: governance(sublimation-forge): cede guardian-feed custody for ONE_WORLD integration

interface_mismatches: docs/governance/ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml is owned by no active track; this packet binds to sublimation-forge-2026-08 because the ruling amends that track's own registry entry (a self-narrowing), matching the #1470 RUDRA admission precedent.

The ONE_WORLD program document (docs/plans/ONE_WORLD_2026-08-30.md) and its custody manifest live on PR #1493's integration branch until that PR merges; this ruling cites them there and does not copy them onto main.

At the current #1493 merge-base the integration changes only tests/test_foundry_guardian_feed.py of the ceded pair; dharma_swarm/foundry/guardian_feed.py is ceded proactively per the operator directive so the guardian-feed surface moves as one custody unit.

The cession replaces two globs (dharma_swarm/foundry/**, tests/test_foundry_*.py) with explicit file lists: a deliberate fail-closed consequence is that any NEW foundry file or foundry test is unowned until a future track amendment re-admits it.
honest_blockers: This packet attests a registry custody amendment and its generated projections only; it does not attest that PR #1493's reconciliation content is correct, reviewed, or mergeable — #1493 carries its own CI and review burden.
The ruling unblocks the packet-scope gate structurally; #1493 must still update from main and re-run its full required check set before merge.
No runtime, provider, deployment, credential, remote-host, or external-effect authority is granted or implied by this custody change.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this single commit: restores the two foundry globs to sublimation-forge-2026-08 owned_surfaces and regenerates the two managed include blocks. Rollback performs no runtime, deployment, provider, credential, or external-state mutation and re-closes the #1493 packet-scope path.
